bibliography.title: Diffusion Language Model Knows the Answer Before It Decodes

sections.title: 2.2 Acceleration Methods for Diffusion Language Models
B.1 Corroborating Results on Early Answer Convergence

abstract_sentences.text: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have recently emerged as an alternative to autoregressive approaches, offering parallel sequence generation and flexible token orders.

evidence.anchor: alternative to autoregressive approaches; parallel sequence generation and flexible token orders

abstract_sentences.text: However, their inference remains slower than that of autoregressive models, primarily due to the cost of bidirectional attention and the large number of refinement steps required for high-quality outputs.

evidence.anchor: inference remains slower ... bidirectional attention ... refinement steps

abstract_sentences.text: In this work, we highlight and leverage an overlooked property of DLMs—early answer convergence: in many cases, the correct answer can be internally identified by half steps before the final decoding step, under both semi-autoregressive and random remasking schedules.

evidence.anchor: overlooked property of DLMs—early answer convergence

abstract_sentences.text: For example, on GSM8K and MMLU, up to 97% and 99% of instances, respectively, can be decoded correctly using only half of the refinement steps.

evidence.anchor: GSM8K and MMLU ... up to 97% and 99% ... half

abstract_sentences.text: Building on this observation, we introduce Prophet, a training-free fast decoding paradigm that enables early commit decoding.

evidence.anchor: introduce Prophet, a training-free fast decoding paradigm

abstract_sentences.text: Specifically, Prophet dynamically decides whether to continue refinement or to go “all-in” (i.e. decode all remaining tokens in one step), using the confidence gap between the top-2 prediction candidates as the criterion.

evidence.anchor: confidence gap between the top-2 prediction candidates

abstract_sentences.text: It integrates seamlessly into existing DLM implementations, incurs negligible overhead, and requires no additional training.

evidence.anchor: incurs negligible overhead, and requires no additional training

abstract_sentences.text: Empirical evaluations on LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B across multiple tasks show that Prophet reduces the number of decoding steps by up to 3.4× while preserving high generation quality, and yields additional speedups when combined with existing acceleration methods.

evidence.anchor: evaluations on LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B ... up to 3.4×

abstract_sentences.text: These results recast DLM decoding as a problem of when to stop sampling, and demonstrate that early answer convergence provides a simple yet powerful mechanism for accelerating DLMs on reasoning, code, and planning tasks with identifiable answer regions.

evidence.anchor: recast DLM decoding as a problem of when to stop sampling

abstract_sentences.text: Our code is available at https://github.com/pixeli99/Prophet.

evidence.anchor: Our code is available at https://github.com/pixeli99/Prophet

claim_closure.claim: Answer-region confidence gap is an effective stopping signal.
claim_closure.method_response: Eq. (4) averages top-1/top-2 logit gaps over answer region A; Eq. (5) maps progress to staged thresholds; Algorithm 1 executes the check.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Tables 1–4 and Table 7 report quality/speed outcomes under the rule across tasks, remasking and schedules.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §6 calls the rule dynamic confidence-gap termination and optimal stopping.

evidence.anchor: average confidence gap gbar_t exclusively over the answer region A
if gbar_t >= tau(p) ... terminate and finalize
dynamically monitors confidence gaps to determine optimal termination points

claim_closure.claim: Prophet is training-free and accelerates without material quality loss.
claim_closure.method_response: Early commit fills remaining masks with current argmax and otherwise follows standard remasking.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 1 reports 1.20×–3.40× speedups with both positive and negative point accuracy changes; no seed, interval or wall-clock evidence.

evidence.anchor: model-agnostic, requires no retraining

claim_closure.claim: Adaptive stopping is preferable to naive static truncation.
claim_closure.method_response: Progress-dependent high/mid/low thresholds trade early risk against late computation.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 3a shows static caps underperform; Table 4 shows Prophet attenuates coarse-block brittleness.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §6 reframes decoding as optimal stopping rather than fixed budget.

evidence.anchor: time-varying risk aversion
static schedules either under-compute ... or over-compute
optimal stopping problem rather than a fixed-budget iteration

claim_closure.claim: Prophet is orthogonal to SDTT and Fast-dLLM.
claim_closure.method_response: Prophet reduces total steps, while SDTT/Fast-dLLM reduce model trajectory or per-step cost.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 2a/b shows 3.21× and 7.66× combinations on LLaDA GSM8K.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Appendix A reiterates system-level synergy as future exploration.

final_judgment.single_storyline: DLM 的答案区常比完整 CoT 更早稳定；Prophet 用 answer-region top-2 confidence gap 与进度阈值把固定步数改写为 optimal stopping，并在稳定时一次性提交剩余 mask（p.4–7 §3–4；p.10 §6）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Figure 1–2、Eq. (4)–(5)、Algorithm 1、Table 1–4，使现象、规则、主结果和三类消融形成闭环（p.4–10）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: MMLU Figure 4、错误 Figure 5、定性 Table 5、answer-region 定义、(L,T,B) 配置和 staged/linear 对照移入 p.15–19；这保留主文紧凑度，却降低边界、错误保守性和复现自足性。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 先以 Figure 1 分布证明答案提前出现，再以 Figure 2 轨迹分离 answer/CoT，随后用 Eq. (4)–(5) 和 Algorithm 1 压缩为停止器，最后用 Table 2–4 检验正交性与鲁棒性（p.4–10）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: “statistically on par”“negligible degradation”“safe”缺少 seed、方差、检验、wall-clock、样本数和 false-positive early-exit 率；早期比例还使用已含 ground truth 的筛选分母（p.4、p.8、p.15–18）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 任何提前停止主张都应同时给出停止信号形式化定义、正确／错误轨迹对照、静态截断与既有加速器对照，以及实际停止成本和质量不确定性；本论文的 Eq. (4)–(5)、Figure 5、Table 2–4 提供了这一结构（p.5–10、p.17）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 规则适用于答案区由输入结构确定、稳定性可观测且错误轨迹持续波动的结构化任务；开放式生成、变量长度答案或 confidence 与 correctness 脱钩时，须先验证 answer-span 与停止信号（p.15、p.18）。
